units.title: In-plant training in a company (Within state or out state) involved in R&D / Process design /
topics: Product Design /Manufacturing (QA / QC / Plant engineering / Production / Consultancy / Technical services / Engineering Projects)

units.title: At the end of 1st phase and 2nd Phase of in-plant training, each student needs to submit written
topics: report based on the work carried out during in-plant training with weekly diary
The report and weekly diary will be counter signed by the supervisor / in charge of company
BRANCH NAME: B.E.(PLASTIC TECHNOLOGY) Subject Code: 3182301 w.e.f

units.title: During 1st & 2nd phase of in-plant training, faculty from the institute need to visit the specific
topics: organization / industry to have the update regarding the progress of the student from the industry representative as well as to have interaction with the industry representative

units.title: The performance of the student will be assessed based on the written report, weekly diary & a
topics: presentation to the committee consisting of two expert faculty members assigned from the University

units.title: Generalized points need to be taken care by the students during the report preparation of in-plant training are
topics: etc. of the industry & production capacity • Process Flow Diagram • Manufacturing operations & processes Involved • Formulations/ raw materials and product testing • Specifications of equipment & process parameters • Trouble Shooting for product quality • Safety measures of the plant /process/storage/machines
Students will be assigned a grade based on the written report
weekly diary & a presentation evaluated by the committee of the expert faculty members
